name: Wizard
description: A master of arcane magic who harnesses the power of the cosmos and the elements to bend reality to their will.

features.name: Spellcasting
features.description: Wizards can cast spells from their spellbook, spending spell slots to harness their magical abilities.

features.name: Arcane Recovery
features.description: Once per day during a short rest, a wizard can recover expended spell slots with a combined level that does not exceed half their wizard level (rounded up).

bloodlineBonus: Increased spell damage by 2 for spells of chosen bloodline type.

name: Fighter
description: A master of martial combat, skilled with a variety of weapons and armor. Fighters excel in physical prowess and adaptability, making them versatile in any combat situation.

features.name: Fighting Style
features.description: Choose a fighting style that enhances your combat capabilities.

features.name: Second Wind
features.description: A surge of energy allows you to regain hit points equal to 1d10 + your fighter level once per short rest.

features.name: Action Surge
features.description: Take one additional action on your turn, usable once per short rest.

bloodlineBonus: Increase your attack or damage rolls with weapons of your choice.

name: Rogue
description: Rogues are cunning and skilled at stealth, deception, and infiltration. They thrive on agility and their sharp wits to navigate the challenges of the world.

features.name: Sneak Attack
features.description: You can deal extra damage when you have advantage on an attack roll or if an ally is within 5 feet of the target.

features.name: Cunning Action
features.description: You can take the Dash, Disengage, or Hide action as a bonus action on your turn.

features.name: Roguish Archetype
features.description: You choose an archetype that provides additional features and abilities.

bloodlineBonus: Gain proficiency in dexterity saving throws and a bonus to stealth checks.

name: Cleric
description: Clerics are divine spellcasters who draw power from their deities, wielding magic to heal and smite. They serve as intermediaries between mortals and their gods, often being called upon to defend the faith and spread their deity's influence.

features.name: Divine Magic
features.description: Clerics can cast spells by channeling the divine power of their deity. They prepare spells from their spell list and can use them to heal or harm.

features.name: Channel Divinity
features.description: Once per short rest, the cleric can use their action to channel divine energy and either heal allies or turn undead.

features.name: Divine Intervention
features.description: Starting at 10th level, the cleric can call upon their deity for assistance, which may result in miraculous outcomes.

bloodlineBonus: You gain proficiency in one additional skill of your choice related to your deity's domain.

name: Ranger
description: Rangers are skilled hunters and trackers, adept at navigating the wilderness and defending their allies from threats. They combine martial prowess with nature magic to become versatile combatants.

features.name: Favored Enemy
features.description: Choose a type of creature, gaining bonuses on tracking and attacking it.

features.name: Natural Explorer
features.description: You are adept at traversing a favored terrain, gaining benefits such as increased movement and survival skills.

features.name: Fighting Style
features.description: Choose a fighting style that enhances your combat capabilities.

features.name: Spellcasting
features.description: You gain the ability to cast spells from the ranger spell list.

bloodlineBonus: You gain a +1 bonus to your Dexterity and have proficiency in survival checks.
